selection_rule: every seed with all four registered fixed-seed sampled-K draws at the exact pass-8 target; arms are retained independently; approved all-step source exclusions are honored, identical metric repeats are deduplicated, and unapproved conflicting retries abort

endpoint_integrity_policy.comparison: exact equality of the complete sampled metrics payload
endpoint_integrity_policy.identical_repeats: deduplicate; never treat as additional draws
endpoint_integrity_policy.unapproved_conflicts: abort without writing a replacement result
endpoint_integrity_policy.approved_exclusions: omit all efficacy steps; retain reason, source hash, and amendment

endpoint_audit.reason: conflicting duplicate sampled rows in the registered job
endpoint_audit.scope: all efficacy endpoints and training steps for this run

exclusions.reason: conflicting duplicate sampled rows in the registered job
exclusions.scope: all efficacy endpoints and training steps for this run
